title: Dutch museum moon rock turned out to be petrified wood

tellings.quote: And then you have the Apollo Goodwill tour where I think it was through Neil Armstrong, the American ambassador, ended up with this moon rock or whatever, went to the the former prime minister of the Netherlands gave him the thing.

plain: During the Apollo goodwill tour, when the astronauts toured the world after the 1969 Moon landing, the American ambassador in the Netherlands came by a moon rock, through Neil Armstrong as Michels thinks, and gave it to a former Dutch prime minister; the rock later ended up in a Dutch museum and turned out to be petrified wood. Michels tells it himself, hedging on details, in a conversation about doubts over official space history.
